name: io.github.DavidNgugi/flowscope
title: FlowScope UX Flow Analyser
description: Turn YouTube product demos into structured UX flow reports, and compare demos side by side.

environmentVariables.name: FLOWSCOPE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the running FlowScope backend. '/api' is appended if absent.

environmentVariables.name: FLOWSCOPE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, only needed when the backend sits behind an authenticating proxy.

environmentVariables.name: FLOWSCOPE_MAX_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Default seconds that flowscope_analyze_video waits for a job before returning a job id.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Requires a running FlowScope backend plus ffmpeg and an LLM provider key on the backend host. Not a hosted service.
